## Captured methodology {#sec-method}

This section comes from `includes/method.qmd`. Its source marker should name that
file when you select and copy a sentence. The data and media are declared local
resources, captured with the source before Python executes.

::: {.callout-note title="Reproducible by construction"}
The experiment input is resolved once, before the first cell runs. A later run
cannot silently change the evidence behind this published report.
:::

We estimate an expectation with $N$ independent samples:

$$
\widehat{I}_N = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} f(X_i)
$$ {#eq-estimator}

The estimator in @eq-estimator connects the experiment to the convergence plot.
